title: Δ Flow Matching for Robot Foundation Models

tldr.en: Construct mildly noisy sources from recent action/visual history and learn residual transport for single-step VLA/WAM generation.
tldr.zh: 从近期动作或视觉历史构造带轻噪声的起点，学习残差迁移，实现 VLA/WAM 单步生成。

evaluation_scope.en: π0.5, ImageWAM and Fast-WAM on LIBERO/Plus; A100-80GB local policy-call timing. Training-free WAM action-source adaptation is a separate experiment.
evaluation_scope.zh: π0.5、ImageWAM、Fast-WAM 的 LIBERO/Plus 实验；A100-80GB 本地策略调用计时。WAM 动作起点的免训练适配是另一个实验设置。
